sentences.text: Dimas merapikan peta kuno yang kusut sebelum dipajang di vitrin.

sentences.text: Sang desainer naik ke podium kecil untuk memperkenalkan koleksi barunya.
sentences.en: The designer stepped onto a small podium to introduce her new collection.
sentences.ko: 디자이너가 신작을 소개하려고 작은 연단에 올랐어요.

sentences.text: Dimas membaca berita lama tentang ekstradisi pencuri yang menggondol lukisan museum.
sentences.en: Dimas read an old news story about the extradition of the thief who made off with a museum painting.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 박물관 그림을 훔쳐 간 도둑의 범죄인 인도에 관한 옛 기사를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Di ruang istirahat, Putri menonton berita tentang ekstradisi seorang pengusaha buronan.
sentences.en: In the break room, Putri watched news about the extradition of a fugitive businessman.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 휴게실에서 도주한 사업가의 범죄인 인도 뉴스를 봤어요.

sentences.text: Museum menyimpan mikrofon pertama dari stasiun penyiaran radio kota.
sentences.en: The museum keeps the first microphone from the city's radio broadcasting station.
sentences.ko: 박물관은 시 라디오 방송국의 첫 마이크를 보관하고 있어요.

sentences.text: Putri masuk ke ruang penyiaran untuk mengumumkan anak yang terpisah dari ibunya.
sentences.en: Putri went into the broadcast room to announce a child who had been separated from his mother.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 엄마와 떨어진 아이를 안내 방송하려고 방송실에 들어갔어요.

sentences.text: Dimas mengatur cahaya ruang pamer supaya terlihat lebih artistik.
sentences.en: Dimas adjusted the gallery lighting so it would look more artistic.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 전시실이 더 예술적으로 보이도록 조명을 맞췄어요.

sentences.text: Pajangan etalase buatan Putri dipuji sangat artistik oleh manajer.
sentences.en: The manager praised Putri's window display as very artistic.
sentences.ko: 매니저는 푸트리가 꾸민 쇼윈도가 아주 예술적이라고 칭찬했어요.

sentences.text: Diorama itu menggambarkan dua faksi istana yang saling bersaing.
sentences.en: The diorama depicts two rival factions at the palace.
sentences.ko: 그 디오라마는 서로 경쟁하던 궁정의 두 파벌을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Di kantor, para pegawai terbagi menjadi dua faksi soal jadwal libur.
sentences.en: In the office, the staff split into two factions over the holiday schedule.
sentences.ko: 사무실 직원들은 휴가 일정을 두고 두 파벌로 갈렸어요.
